reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1200/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-03), and the disputed bills behind that surge are dominated by bills built on ACTUAL meter reads rather than ESTIMATED ones (E-02), while no tariff change occurred in the period (E-04) — ruling out field-read/estimate-substitution and rate changes as the driver. This pattern is best explained by a billing import validation-rule change around August (H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE) that introduced systematic errors into bills generated from actual reads, which customers then dispute.
